jane_sales: Heads-up — AstraNova told the AE they won't start the POC unless we can guarantee EU data residency for the trial, meet a latency SLO ~99.95 (p95), and cap monthly overage to their budget. They want exec signoff ASAP. Expected load: ~200k tokens/day steady, bursts to 1M/day. Need SRE/ENG + pricing support. cc @clara_eng @mike_se :exclamation:

mike_se: Quick clarifying q — do they require Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) or is Hosted EU region with contract controls sufficient? Lead times differ a lot. Also confirm model family: RLHF chat vs embeddings/rerank pipeline.

clara_eng: If Hosted-EU is acceptable we can provision a dedicated pool with isolation and batching. Ballpark: 200k/day steady + bursts could map to 2 x A100-equivalent nodes to hit p95 ~200ms, p50 ~80ms depending on prompt sizes and KV cache hit. Need sample prompt distro to refine.

jane_sales: They prefer hosted (no on-prem) but insist on contractual EU residency + higher SLA. CISO requested SOC2 attestation + answers to their security questionnaire today. I uploaded the SQ to the drive.

tara_revenue: From pricing: we can offer a POC commercial: 20% off list with an option to convert to Reserved capacity (better discount). To guarantee SLA & capacity we'll need an upfront minimum; suggest a 3-month baseline. What baseline should we request?

clara_eng: Baseline for dedicated sizing = ~200k tokens/day (~6M tokens/month). If they convert to reserved we can size efficiently. For immediate unblock we can enable an autoscale group with burst credits for limited windows but that ups cost.

mike_se: On sec questionnaire: CISO asked about key management and egress. We can offer customer-managed KMS in EU and IP allowlist for the POC. I'll start the SQ draft but need to confirm KMS in EU timeline. Tag me if legal needs any technical attestation.

legal_triage_bot: legal-bot: Security questionnaire received. Priority: HIGH. Assigned to @legal_ops. Requested SLA exception template and EU data residency addendum. ETA initial draft: 48 hours.

dante_product: Suggest interim "hosted-EU + guardrails": Hosted EU region + strict egress rules + customer KMS + SOC2 attestation + written SLA for POC window, with commitment to migrate to Dedicated if they sign. Buys time vs lengthy private provisioning.

clara_eng: Agree with @dante_product. If we go interim hosted config, ops needs a deployment manifest. Example quick test (sanitized):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.prod.eu/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-14b","input":"<test prompt>","max_tokens":512}'
```

clara_eng: Also need their prompt length distribution + concurrency pattern. Short prompts (<=64 tokens) are great for batching; long streaming outputs need different kernel configs.

jane_sales: I'll ask for a short load sample and the CISO contact. I'll DM their CISO to accept a temporary DPA for the trial. ETA: 2 hours.

tara_revenue: I'll draft a pro-forma POC pricing and a 1-page conversion path showing committed options and discounts. Initial numbers in ~4 hours.

mike_se: I'll start filling the security questionnaire and confirm EU KMS support. If legal needs technical doc snippets, ping me.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: CREATED dedicated-pool-request #DC-7971 (region: eu-west). Provisioning ETA: 72 hours. Temporary hosted-EU guardrail config prepared.

jane_sales: Plan: 1) present interim hosted + guardrails + SOC2 + DPA to customer so POC can start, 2) legal drafts addendum, 3) ops starts dedicated pool as fallback, 4) revenue ties pricing to conversion path. Ping me here with blockers. :thumbsup: 

dante_product: Recommend internal exec touchpoint if legal needs SLA exceptions signed by exec (CEO/CPO). I can coordinate if needed.

clara_eng: Flagging risk: if their prompt distro is long-context heavy, latency could degrade. Track this.

jane_sales: Got it. Pushing for sample payload now. Thanks all. :pray:
